verdict.rationale: Zapier's own Platform CLI docs list webhooks among the trigger types developers can build, and a community user reports that implementing a webhook with Zapier was easy. However, nothing in the pack documents a user-exposed custom webhook URL that receives arbitrary HTTP requests and starts a Zap run with the payload. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a catch-hook/custom webhook URL trigger, payload mapping into the workflow run, and hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a custom webhook URL that receives external HTTP requests and starts a workflow run with the payload

citations.quote: Zapier Platform CLI enables developers to build integrations using Node.js v22, OAuth1/OAuth2 authentication, webhooks, polling triggers, and HTTP middleware.
I am using Zapier because their service was very easy to implement a webhook for what I needed
